# Laboratory-abnormality label coverage (generated by experiments/check_laboratory_label_coverage.py)

HPO terms whose logical definition names a ChEBI entity (hp-base.owl): 688 (increased 341, abnormal, no direction 205, decreased 142). Terms mapped to a Human-GEM metabolite: 222 through an equivalent form (conjugate acid or base, tautomer), 167 through a specific form (an is_a child named after the compound, such as L-phenylalanine), 3 through a manual mapping (potassium(1+) to K+, which Human-GEM annotates with the potassium atom), 6 left out as class terms (more than three metabolites), 290 unmapped. Generic pseudo-metabolites ('[protein]') are excluded; an unannotated gene-metabolite pair is unlabelled, not normal.
